name: Meyer Apparel Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1993, Meyer Apparel Ltd is engaged in the retailing of ready-made garments.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
MAL is promoted by KBSH Group, Haryana, and the Singapore-based Thakral Group of Companies, for the wholesaling and retailing of Men’s suits and Trousers, and manufacturing through contractors. Currently, it is actively exploring new avenues and strategies, and is expanding its presence in the online retail space

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -26.0% over past five years.
